summary: unexpected TOKEN, expected one of: LIST
rationale: A token must fit the current production.
Unknown statements cannot create model elements.
An open delimiter needs a closing delimiter.

summary: id ID is already in use
rationale: Nodes and groups share an identifier namespace.
A parent relation cannot point to its child.
A parent must exist when its child is inserted.

summary: parent ID is not a group
invalid edge direction TOKEN; expected L, R, T, B
rationale: Each endpoint requires one of four port sides.

summary: edge endpoint ID does not exist
rationale: Edges do not create implicit nodes.

summary: edge endpoint ID is not a service or junction
rationale: The database requires node records at both endpoints.

summary: endpoint ID has a group modifier but the edge stays in one group
rationale: A boundary modifier cannot connect members of the same defined group.

summary: alignment requires at least two members
rationale: An alignment relates at least two nodes.

summary: alignment member ID is not a service or junction
rationale: Alignment members must resolve to nodes.

summary: alignment lists ID more than once
rationale: One alignment cannot repeat a node.
